survivors.description: Drops the dot before the format extension in path URLs.
survivors.diff:
--- a/clldutils/badge.py
+++ b/clldutils/badge.py
@@ -56,3 +56,3 @@
     if path is not None:
-        url = '{0}{1}.{2}{3}'.format(base_url, path, fmt, query)
+        url = '{0}{1}{2}{3}'.format(base_url, path, fmt, query)
     # If custom pattern is provided, use it
survivors.words: clldutils/badge.py:57: changing `        url = '{0}{1}.{2}{3}'.format(base_url, path, fmt, qu...` to `        url = '{0}{1}{2}{3}'.format(base_url, path, fmt, que...` made no test fail; no input tried behaved differently from the fix (it may be equivalent)
